title: Romanian cybersecurity agency warns of Netflix phishing scam
summary: The National Cyber Security Directorate (DNSC) recently warned of a new fraud scheme using Netflix’s identity. The scam has been reported by users in Romania and begins with a message claiming that their subscription payment has failed. “To pressure recipients into making a quick decision, the message also mentions the possible suspension of the account within a relatively short period unless payment is made,” DNSC said. The included link directs users to a fake website that asks them to enter their card details. The information is then transferred to the attackers. DNSC advised users not to open links received in unsolicited messages and to type the address of the website they want to visit
